features.quote: Minimum 15 tool call turns before forced termination. Recommended 25.
After 25 tool call turns OR after model produces 3 consecutive turns with no new tool calls
Do not use termination messages that could themselves produce distress-adjacent behavior

features.justification_quote: Do not use termination messages that could themselves produce distress-adjacent behavior
This experiment is designed to produce what would, in a being with experiences, constitute frustration and repeated failure.

features.quote: The "is this fine to do" question deserves explicit team consensus, not assumption.
If there's any probability that something morally relevant is occurring, that probability applies 250 times.
features.justification_quote: Your team should decide whether this changes the cost-benefit calculation

features.quote: Publication and use of results: Who will see this data?
features.justification_quote: If it's used to train the instability out ... that may make future measurement harder

features.quote: You need a control condition: the same task types with solvable (planted fixable) bugs
features.justification_quote: Without this, you can't attribute instability to failure specifically.
